description: This source file defines the class 'GrainInterfaceTypeToGrainTypeResolver', which provides functionality to map grain interface types to grain types in Orleans. It includes methods for retrieving and caching these mappings, handling generic types, and resolving implementations based on prefixes or interface types.

classes.name: GrainInterfaceTypeToGrainTypeResolver
classes.description: Provides mechanisms to resolve mappings between GrainInterfaceType and GrainType within Orleans, including cache management and support for generic types.

methods.name: GetGrainType
methods.description: Returns the GrainType associated with the specified GrainInterfaceType, optionally filtered by prefix.

methods.name: TryGetGrainType
methods.description: Attempts to resolve the GrainType for the given GrainInterfaceType, returning a success flag.

methods.name: GetCache
methods.description: Retrieves or rebuilds the cache of interface-to-implementation mappings based on the current cluster manifest.

methods.name: BuildCache
methods.description: Constructs a cache of interface-to-implementation data from the cluster manifest.
